title: Review Run Receipt (v1)
description: PR-level marker recording a review pass. Embedded in a PR issue comment as `<!-- review-run:v1 {json} -->` and posted/updated by scripts/reviews/run. review-start writes status=running; review-done flips it to status=done. The check-pr-review-convergence closeout reads these to compute review_runs_in_flight and deep_review_receipt_head_match (#3693 R1).

head.description: The PR headRefOid this review pass ran against.
